ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERSTATUS_CCD
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus
AS(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT 
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_STATUS AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	,BCD.BNK_CODE

FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION 

    SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT
    ,BCD.CUST_STATUS
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	,BCD.BNK_CODE
 FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
 LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerStatusTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerStatusTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerStatus  ( 
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerStatusNote
,SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId AS CustomerStatusTypeId
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,SRC.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId

 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerStatus  ( 
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId AS CustomerStatusTypeId
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

END
